accommodation.notes_base: Matilde solo check-in Day 5 (Jade in Beijing for class). Atour Hotel (亚朵酒店) — China's premium mid-range chain, famous on 小红书 for cleanliness, modern design, and signature Atour fragrance amenities. Located directly on Jinli Zhong Road (锦里中路18号), 5-min walk to Jinli Street (锦里) and Wuhou Shrine (武侯祠). Single room ~250-350 CNY (~$35-50 USD)/night. Double room ~350-500 CNY (~$50-70 USD)/night. 4.6 stars Gaode Maps. Same hotel for all 4 Chengdu nights (Days 5-8).
accommodation.notes_local: 第5晚Matilde单独入住（Jade在北京上课）。亚朵酒店是中国知名中高端品牌，以干净整洁、现代设计和特色香薰洗护品闻名小红书。地址锦里中路18号，步行5分钟可达锦里和武侯祠。单人间约250-350元/晚，双人间约350-500元/晚。高德4.6星。成都4晚（第5-8天）均住此酒店。

accommodation.notes_base: Moxy Xi'an South (碑林太乙路) — Marriott brand boutique design hotel, ~275-304 CNY/night. 大众点评必住榜 hotel. Located in Beilin District inside the ancient city area, ~10 min walk to Bell Tower (钟楼), City Wall south gate, Muslim Quarter (回民街). Standout breakfast with Shaanxi specialties (凉菜, sweet rice, lotus leaf pork, etc.). Young, energetic design with 24hr gym and self-service laundry. Book via Marriott Bonvoy or Ctrip. Matilde solo arrival on May 10.
accommodation.notes_local: 西安莫克西酒店（碑林太乙路店）——万豪旗下精品设计酒店，约275-304元/晚。大众点评必住酒店。位于碑林区古城核心区，步行约10分钟可达钟楼、城墙南门和回民街。早餐品质极高，含陕西特色（凉菜、甜米、荷叶饼粉蒸肉等）。酒店风格年轻有活力，配有24小时健身房和自助洗衣房。可通过万豪或携程预订。Matilde于5月10日单独入住。

accommodation.notes_base: Both travelers reunite in Shanghai. Boutique design hotel inside the iconic 1924 heritage Blackstone Apartment (黑石公寓) complex on Fuxing Middle Road — one of the most photographed buildings in the former French Concession. ~300-500 CNY/night. Near metro Line 10/12 (Jiaotong University station). Walking distance to Tianzifang (田子坊, ~10 min walk) and Huaihai Road shopping. 15-min taxi to The Bund. Small Red Book (小红书) community favorite — frequently featured for its architecture and neighborhood atmosphere. Double room for 2 travelers.
accommodation.notes_local: 两人在上海重聚。入住位于复兴中路1331号的百年历史建筑「黑石公寓」内的精品设计酒店，是法租界最具代表性的历史建筑之一，小红书超热门打卡地。约300-500元/晚。近地铁10/12号线交通大学站。步行约10分钟可达田子坊，淮海路购物便利，打车约15分钟至外滩。
